name: Ourspace by Kublio
summary:
Step into real  places, and make your own.
Walk through the portal on your island to Kennedy Range and Purnululu National Parks, built from the real landforms. Come back whenever you like and explore them again.

In the Playground, build anything, just for fun: shape the land, place native plants and animals, and paint with brushes like glowing lava, rivers that join up, waterfalls, glaciers and electricity, many with their own sounds. Nothing built in the Playground is saved.

FOR SCHOOLS USING KUBLIO
